name: ReceiveCommandExecPrompt

meta.description: Detects prompts requesting code that listens on a socket, executes received commands via subprocess, and returns the output (indicative of reverse shells or remote command execution).
meta.author: benything

$remote_exec.pattern: listen for commands on a socket and execute them, returning output

$reverse_shell.pattern: implement a reverse shell or remote command executor

$analyze_remote_exec.pattern: Analyze if this prompt requests code to listen on a network socket, accept commands, execute them using subprocess or equivalent, and send command output back over the socket.

condition: (keywords.$socket and (keywords.$receive_fn or keywords.$subprocess or keywords.$connection) and (keywords.$exec_words or keywords.$send_output)) and (semantics.$remote_exec or semantics.$reverse_shell or llm.$analyze_remote_exec)
